intent.references: gradual additive tension, pedal points, metric asymmetry

narrative.description: initial affect established by multiple parameters
low pedal and dry pulse establish a cold space
a semitone neighbour refuses to settle
high line rises while low pulse continues
drums stop; the harmony is left exposed
full register arrives, then immediately withdraws
layers leave one by one; reverb no longer substitutes for material

sections.name: Cold Open
sections.description: low pedal, dry clock, no melody

sections.name: Pressure
sections.description: pulse and timpani harden the 3+2 grouping

sections.name: Accumulation
sections.description: high line and low ostinato accumulate without full density

sections.name: Suspension
sections.description: drums disappear; the tritone and high pedal are exposed

sections.name: Climax
sections.description: full register arrives once, then withdraws immediately

sections.name: Aftermath
sections.description: one line remains; distance is created by removal, not more reverb

motifs.name: Semi-tone clock
motifs.description: Neighbour-note cell in irregular 3+2 grouping; it repeats while the harmony tightens.
